thread:
incident-bot: [ALERT] p99 latency breach on dedicated pool eu-west-2 (pool-id: ded-eu2-07). SLO p99 > 1200ms, current p99 3400ms over last 5m. Queue depth spiked to 14k. Paging on-call: @maya_sre

maya_sre: Acked. Looking. Any customer-visible errors?

liam_platform: Seeing streaming stalls and tail spikes across hotshot and reserved pools. Autoscaler delayed scaling for ~3m due to warmup handshakes failing. Traces show handshake timeout 502 between allocator and runner.

sachin_runtime: digging into logs. runner warmup logs show OOMs then container restarts. Possibly kernel selection causing slow init on quantized models. Dumping last warmup events:
```
runner.init model=llama-quant v=2.1 warmup=failed reason=mem-pressure pid=4321
handshake:error timeout=15000
```

maya_sre: Are these new customers or mid-tier? Amanda_cs?

amanda_cs: Customer-impact: two enterprise customers reported degraded streaming in EU for last 10m. No data loss, but 40% of streaming sessions hit stalls >5s.

ev an_product: Which model variants are affected? Could we fallback to smaller quantized variant?

liam_platform: It's across multiple model families but heavy on llama-quant/opt-8k. Fallback path exists but requires routing change; can toggle route for eu pool to hosted fallback for affected accounts.

maya_sre: Immediate mitigation options?

sachin_runtime: Short-term:
- Rollback kernel change deployed 12:42 UTC (might be related)
- Temporarily disable warmup on new runners to avoid OOM loop
- Route priority queues to hosted fallback (requires ops toggle)
Longer-term: improve handshake retry/backoff.

liam_platform: Ops toggle ready. I'll flip routing for enterprise queue now. @ops-bot please run the routing change.

ops-bot: /run change-route --from=dedicated:eu2:priority --to=hosted:eu2:fallback --dry-run=false
ops-bot: change applied. routing delta: 95% priority -> hosted fallback. Confirming metrics.

incident-bot: routing change observed. p95 reduced from 1.2s->0.6s within 90s. p99 trending down but still above SLO.

maya_sre: Good. Continue monitoring. Any plan to heal dedicated pool?

sachin_runtime: Killed a few hot runners stuck in warmup. Redeploying patched runtime to eu2 hotshot now (image: runtime-v2.1.1-patch). Deploy command:
```
deploy runtime eu2 image=runtime-v2.1.1-patch rollout=canary 10%
```

liam_platform: Can we scale up reserved pool as temporary capacity? Billing OK for overage?

ev an_product: Enterprise SLAs allow emergency overprovisioning. Amanda, approve?

amanda_cs: Approved for affected customers until 06:00 UTC. Please log change and cost center.

maya_sre: Notified on-call backup @liam_platform. @sachin_runtime coordinate final rollback if patch fails.

sachin_runtime: Patch successful on 10% canary. Warmup failures reduced in canary logs. I'll ramp to 100% over 5m.

ops-bot: Scaling reserved pool ded-eu2-07 +4 nodes (hotshot) initiated.

incident-bot: After actions p99 5m now 950ms. Queue depth 1.2k. Streaming stall alerts decreased.

liam_platform: Re-enable KV cache prefetching? It was disabled earlier; might reduce coldpath.

sachin_runtime: Re-enabling prefetch cautiously. Doing one host-group at a time.

ev an_product: Customer comms: Amanda you send a brief update to customers affected.

amanda_cs: Drafting message now. ETA 5m.

maya_sre: Monitoring for 30m then close. Add postmortem and include runbook gap: autoscaler handshake timeout handling and warmup OOMs.

liam_platform: I'll create incident ticket and schedule follow-up with runtime and autoscaler owners.

sachin_runtime: Notes: root cause likely combination of a kernel selection change + increased burst causing memory pressure during warmup. Recommend: improved admission control, limit concurrent warmups per runner, and faster circuit for handshakes.

maya_sre: Thanks team. Leaving channel for now. If regressions occur, reopen.
